title: Formal Runtime Verification (Temporal-Logic Monitors) for Agent Action Streams

original_idea.body:
# Formal Runtime Verification (Temporal-Logic Monitors) for Agent Action Streams

**Problem:** Many safety constraints are temporal, and an LLM monitor judging individual actions can miss the temporal pattern.

**Direction:** Import runtime verification with temporal logic (LTL/past-time LTL). Specify a handful of safety properties as formulas, synthesize automaton monitors over the action stream, and evaluate on SHADE-Arena for catch rate and false alarms vs an LLM monitor.

**Why it matters:** Adds exact, cheap, interpretable enforcement of temporal safety properties as a complementary deterministic layer. Lightweight, no training.

**Relevant context:** Runtime verification (Bauer/Leucker/Schallhart); layered guardrails (arXiv:2604.05229).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: deterministic temporal-property enforcement complements fuzzy LLM monitors for runtime controls.

low_compute.reasoning: Automaton monitors over logged traces, CPU.

novelty.reasoning: Runtime verification mature; LTL monitors for agent action streams in control plausibly open.
